A.scope: integration plan, flag matrix, contract index and report validator

B.scope: actual isolated integration in product code under a registered Story allowlist
prerequisites: the DYN policy to enable accepted
owner-assigned Story, file allowlist and run budget
B.required_checks_note: Each command must appear verbatim in the report with exit 0, no failure, no skip (the PostgreSQL run must not skip) and at least one test; product_diff paths must be in candidate_files.

states.synthetic_pass: validator and fixtures only; not product evidence
states.accepted_local_integration: actual isolated Go/HTTP/PostgreSQL evidence for every matrix cell, independent review and Story link
states.production: out of scope for this card; never reported here

stop_conditions: any off-mode difference from the baseline
any protection boundary regression (scope, approval, deletion, correction, revision)
